files.description: Hotel bookings (300 rows): booking_id (whole number), state (paid, cancelled, refunded or pending; mostly lower case, some with other capitals or extra spaces), total (booking amount, two decimals; refunded bookings are negative), nights (whole number; about 2% empty).

task_text: Cancelled bookings bring no revenue, so set their total to 0 (the state labels vary in capital letters and spaces). Then report the revenue per state, with the state names in lower case without surrounding spaces. `result` should be a Series indexed by state with the summed totals.
intended_computation: Clean state (strip, lower; 4 states), set total to 0 for cancelled bookings and sum total per state; the cancelled state therefore has revenue 0.

acceptable_variants.notes: totals may be rounded to 2 decimals.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the two-step indexing assignment writes into a temporary, so cancelled totals are not set to 0

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
